description: Defines the 'VacancyAttachment' entity class for the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin, representing attachments linked to job vacancies, with properties for file details and relational mapping to a vacancy.

classes.name: VacancyAttachment
classes.description: Entity class representing a vacancy attachment, including properties for file details, relationships, and accessor/mutator methods for each property.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the vacancy attachment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the vacancy attachment.

methods.name: setVacancy
methods.description: Associates a Vacancy with this attachment.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the file, if specified.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the file.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: setFileSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the file, as a resource or string.

methods.name: setFileContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the file.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment associated with the attachment.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets a comment for the attachment.
